body.statement: Under the finite-candidate, compact-parameter, covariance-eigenvalue, cross-SCC separation, and iid Gaussian sampling conditions, \[\sup_{G_0\in\mathcal F,\,\Sigma_0\in\mathcal M_{G_0}}\Pr_{\Sigma_0}\{\operatorname{SCC}(\widehat G_n)\ne\operatorname{SCC}(G_0)\}\le\min\left\{1,\frac{4p(p+1)\overline M^2}{n\delta^2}\right\}.\] In particular, \(\widehat G_n\) is uniformly SCC-consistent for fixed \(p\), fixed finite \(\mathcal F\), and fixed \(\delta>0\) and \(\overline M<\infty\).
body.justification: The displayed probability bound uses the cross-SCC covariance-image separation, the upper covariance-eigenvalue bound, and iid Gaussian covariance concentration; stability, edge strength, and error scale do not enter it.
body.gap: Chen, Drton, and Wang provide covariance-perturbation recovery for DAG source ordering; cyclic SCC model images and their explicit cross-partition margin are not treated.
body.consumer: It gives an attaining selector for prospectively specified fixed-dimensional signaling-network families.
